content_text:
Hi Roger,
Excited to see the remaster of No Country announced on criterion. Looking forward to watching it!
I was curious what thoughts you have on the HDR grading/transfer process? Specifically in regards to remastering an older film where it wasn’t a consideration during the original production.
Do you have a preferred version SDR or HDR if you were going to watch at home?
